# Copilot instructions for this worktree

- This directory is a dedicated git worktree created by agent-kanban. Edit files freely, but only inside this directory.
- Do NOT commit, push, rebase or switch branches. agent-kanban commits your changes when you finish.
- Stay within the scope of the task. Do not create unrelated files or refactor code the task does not touch.
- Before finishing, run the relevant tests/linters if the project has them and fix any failures you introduced.
- End with a short summary: what you did, what you did not do, and what a reviewer should look at.
